decisions.boundary_condition: Do not rank United above other preferred carriers solely from this habit; the evidence only establishes repeated inclusion in multi-carrier sets.
decisions.canonical_value: Include United as a soft preferred carrier option when it is otherwise competitive and compatible with current trip constraints.
decisions.condition: When searching for commercial flights and no current-trip instruction specifies a different carrier set.
decisions.default_action: Include United among the preferred carrier options when it is otherwise suitable and comparable.
decisions.exception_condition: Use other carriers when United is unavailable, unsuitable for the itinerary, materially worse, or excluded by a current-trip instruction.
decisions.name: united_soft_carrier_option
decisions.preference_value: United is a recurring acceptable carrier to include among preferred flight options, but is not required or uniquely favored.
decisions.rationale: Repeatedly supported across distinct flight requests as an acceptable member of a preferred carrier set. The evidence does not establish exclusivity or priority over other preferred carriers, so it remains a separate soft carrier preference rather than being merged with Delta.

decisions.boundary_condition: This is a soft preference: the evidence supports Delta as a favored option, not as the only acceptable airline or an always-first choice over every other preferred carrier.
decisions.canonical_value: Include and softly favor Delta when it is available, otherwise comparable, and compatible with current trip constraints.
decisions.condition: When choosing among flight carriers and Delta is available while also satisfying the trip's schedule, route, price, and stop constraints.
decisions.default_action: Search for or present Delta options as part of the preferred carrier set, and favor Delta when it is otherwise comparable to alternatives.
decisions.exception_condition: Use another acceptable carrier when Delta is unavailable, materially worse, or does not meet the current trip constraints.
decisions.name: Delta as a soft preferred carrier option
decisions.preference_value: Delta is a preferred airline to include in the flight shortlist, but not an exclusive carrier requirement.
decisions.rationale: Repeatedly supported across distinct flight requests, including one direct statement of preference. Delta and United are contrasting carrier alternatives rather than aliases, so Delta remains a distinct soft preference in the same alternative group.
